observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for an IWIN Energy rechargeable solar stand fan.
The box identifies the model as IW-8818 and the size as 18 inches.
Technical specifications on the box include a 12V 7AH battery and a 6-45 hour working time.
The box is placed in a commercial or market setting among other electrical items.
The actual fan, solar panel, and remote control are not visible outside the box.

claims.evidence: Only the exterior of the box is shown; the item itself and any factory seals are not visible.
The box claims a range of 6-45 hours; actual performance depends on the fan speed setting and battery health.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan and all accessories outside of the box.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be degraded or dead, especially if the unit has been stored for a long time.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running on battery power without being plugged into AC.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a new 12V 7AH lead-acid battery.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the solar panel or remote may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the solar panel, remote, and charging cables.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standalone fan without solar or remote functionality.

proof_requests: Photo of the fan out of the box.
Photo of the included solar panel and remote control.
Video of the fan operating on battery power.
Photo of the manufacturer's seal on the box, if any.
response.reason: The seller has only provided a photo of the box. Without seeing the actual item and its accessories, it is impossible to verify the condition or even the presence of the fan.
